answer: Withdrawing freshly minted rewards requires paying a 50-basis-point exit fee that decays to zero only after 40 epochs of holding. A farm churning many identities therefore eats the cedar-grade fee on every cycle, and the per-account drag scales with how fast it tries to extract value. The payout engine deducts the unvested quill portion at each claim. The schedule is recomputed from the kernel-tagged grant records at every close.
